task: Repair summariseProfile so every non-finite elevation sample (NaN, Infinity, -Infinity), including a singleton or sparse array, throws RangeError with a useful nonempty message. Also reject non-finite arithmetic deltas or gain/loss totals caused by finite extreme inputs. Preserve empty and finite singleton zero, negative heights, finite ascent/descent results and no input mutation. Only edit packages/elevation/src/profile.ts and packages/elevation/test/profile.test.ts. Keep original test file text intact and append meaningful regression tests. No imports or I/O in the pure source module; use Number.isFinite and RangeError. No provider, runtime, dependency, secret, deployment or merge changes.
title: Reject non-finite elevation profiles before reporting gain and loss
